vocab.sentence: My cousin hopes to visit Taiwan.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我的表弟希望來臺灣玩。

vocab.sentence: She wants to find a new job.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她想找一份新工作。

vocab.sentence: He hopes to work as a cook.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他希望擔任廚師。

vocab.sentence: The waiter finished cleaning the table.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位男服務生擦完了桌子。

vocab.sentence: I want to live near the beach.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我想住在海灘附近。

vocab.chinese: 非常驚人的；令人驚喜的
vocab.sentence: It is amazing to see sea turtles.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 看到海龜令人驚喜。

vocab.sentence: Working on a farm was a great experience.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 在農場工作是很棒的經驗。

vocab.sentence: We enjoy getting some fresh air outside.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們喜歡到外面呼吸新鮮空氣。

vocab.sentence: Dad wants to buy some fresh fish.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 爸爸想買一些新鮮的魚。

vocab.sentence: We enjoy swimming in the clear water.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們喜歡在清澈的水中游泳。

vocab.sentence: We hope to see a coral reef.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們希望看到珊瑚礁。

vocab.sentence: Watching sea turtles is a lot of fun.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 看海龜非常有趣。

vocab.sentence: They plan to clean the beach tomorrow.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他們計畫明天清理海灘。

vocab.sentence: I want to learn about different cultures.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我想認識不同的文化。

vocab.sentence: You should practice speaking English every day.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你應該每天練習說英文。

vocab.sentence: We prepared to leave early this morning.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 今天早上我們準備提早離開。

vocab.sentence: Keep practicing, and you will make progress.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 持續練習，你就會進步。

vocab.sentence: My sister practices singing after school.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我妹妹放學後練習唱歌。

vocab.sentence: Give me a break! I just finished working.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 饒了我吧！我才剛工作完。

vocab.sentence: No kidding! He plans to work abroad.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 不開玩笑的！他計畫到國外工作。

vocab.sentence: It is important to keep the beach clean.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 保持海灘乾淨很重要。

vocab.sentence: My cousin wants to learn to surf.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我的表弟想學衝浪。

vocab.sentence: They enjoy working on their uncle's farm.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他們喜歡在叔叔的農場工作。

vocab.sentence: The workers stopped working at five.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 工人們在 5 點停止工作。

vocab.sentence: The waitress needs to clean these tables.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位女服務生需要清理這些桌子。

vocab.sentence: He hopes to work in this factory.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他希望在這間工廠工作。

vocab.sentence: The salesman tried to help us.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位業務員試著幫助我們。

vocab.sentence: The fisherman finished cleaning his boat.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位漁夫清理完他的船。

vocab.sentence: The friendly worker offered to help me.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位友善的工人主動提出要幫我。

vocab.sentence: Learning about another culture is interesting.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 認識另一種文化很有趣。

vocab.sentence: She hopes to make progress in English.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她希望英文能進步。

vocab.sentence: Watching these plants grow is fun.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 看著這些植物成長很有趣。

vocab.sentence: I tried to understand his question.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我試著理解他的問題。

vocab.sentence: Understanding her accent is difficult for me.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 理解她的口音對我來說很困難。

vocab.sentence: Please remember to leave a message.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 請記得留言。

vocab.sentence: My brother likes to surf with friends.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我哥哥喜歡和朋友一起衝浪。

vocab.sentence: They hope to sail around the island.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他們希望駕船繞島航行。

vocab.sentence: We plan to camp near the lake.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們計畫在湖邊露營。

vocab.sentence: It began to rain after lunch.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 午餐後開始下雨。

vocab.sentence: We decided to end the game early.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們決定提早結束遊戲。

vocab.sentence: I hope to visit my cousin soon.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我希望很快就能去看我的表姊。

vocab.sentence: He was unhappy to hear the news.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 聽到這個消息，他很不開心。

phrases.sentence: Long time no see. How are you?
What a surprise! You work here, too.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 真讓人驚訝！你也在這裡工作。

phrases.sentence: What are you up to these days?

phrases.phrase: go on / take a working holiday
phrases.sentence: I hope to go on a working holiday.

phrases.phrase: what kind of + 單數名詞
phrases.sentence: What kind of job do you want?
She hopes to work as a waitress.
Please keep practicing with your classmates.
Give me a break! I need to rest.
No kidding! My cousin can sail a boat.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 不開玩笑的！我的表哥會駕船。

phrases.sentence: We want to learn about sea turtles.
Practicing every day helps you make progress.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 每天練習有助於你進步。

phrases.sentence: In short, learning English takes time.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 簡而言之，學英文需要時間。

phrases.sentence: My cousins enjoy sailing on weekends.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我的表兄弟週末喜歡駕船航行。

tips.label: 先看前面的動詞
tips.text: want、need、plan、hope、choose、prepare 後接 to V；enjoy、finish、keep、practice、mind 後接 V-ing。

tips.label: 叫某人做事
tips.text: ask / tell / want＋人＋to V；叫某人不要做：ask / tell / want＋人＋not to V。

tips.label: 介系詞後用 V-ing
tips.text: How about going camping?／be good at singing；此處的 about、at 後面接動名詞。

tips.label: 用語境分辨意思
tips.text: remember / forget to V 是記得／忘記要去做；remember / forget V-ing 是記得／忘記做過。stop V-ing 是停止原動作；stop to V 是停下來做另一件事。

tips.label: 整件事當主詞
tips.text: V-ing 或 To V 片語當主詞時視為單數：Swimming is fun.／To swim is fun. 也能改成 It is fun to swim.

notes.title: 不定詞作受詞
notes.rule: 主詞＋want / need / plan / hope / choose / prepare / would like＋to＋原形動詞
notes.description: 不定詞用 to＋原形動詞。前面的主要動詞可以變時態，但 to 後仍是原形；不能看到過去時間就把後面的動詞也改成過去式。mean 表示打算時也可接 to V。
examples: We plan to visit a farm.（我們計畫參觀農場。）
She chose to stay home yesterday.（她昨天選擇待在家。）
I would like to learn to sail.（我想學駕船。）

notes.title: 要求或希望某人做某事
notes.description: 人放在主要動詞和不定詞之間。若用代名詞，使用 me、him、her、us、them 等受格。
examples: The worker asked me to wait outside.（工人請我在外面等。）
Mom wants him to practice English.（媽媽希望他練習英文。）

notes.title: 不定詞的否定
notes.description: 本課的否定句型把 not 放在 to 前面。不要把 do not、does not 或 did not 放在這個位置。
examples: Dad told us not to swim here.（爸爸告訴我們不要在這裡游泳。）
Please ask her not to leave yet.（請她先不要離開。）

notes.title: 不定詞修飾名詞
notes.rule: 名詞或不定代名詞＋to V
notes.description: 不定詞放在名詞後，說明可以做或需要做的事情；常見 something to drink、things to do、a way to learn。
examples: We have a lot of work to do.（我們有很多工作要做。）
I need something to drink.（我需要一些喝的東西。）

notes.title: 不定詞表示目的
notes.rule: 主要動作＋to V；to V 可表示為了……
notes.description: 用不定詞說明做前一個動作的目的，常可換成 in order to V。注意此處 to 後面是原形。
examples: We went to the beach to watch sea turtles.（我們去海灘看海龜。）
She got up early in order to catch the bus.（她早起是為了趕上公車。）

notes.title: 形容詞後接不定詞
notes.rule: be＋happy / glad / sad 等形容詞＋to V
notes.description: 不定詞可補充造成某種感受的事情，像 happy to see 或 sad to hear。主要動詞 be 負責表達時態。
examples: I was glad to see my cousin.（我很高興見到表弟。）
She was unhappy to hear the news.（她聽到消息很不開心。）

notes.title: 不定詞的省略
notes.rule: 省略重複的動作內容，但保留 to
notes.description: 前文已提過的內容可省略，例如 want to go camping 省成 want to；不要只刪掉 to 而留下原形動詞。
examples: A: Do you want to go camping? B: Yes, I want to.（你想去露營嗎？想，我想去。）
He wanted to stay, but I did not want to.（他想留下，但我不想。）

notes.title: 固定接動名詞的動詞
notes.description: V-ing 在這裡作受詞，不是現在進行式。也要記住 have fun＋V-ing、have trouble＋V-ing、be busy＋V-ing。
examples: The waiter finished cleaning the table.（服務生擦完了桌子。）
Would you mind opening the door?（可以請你開門嗎？）
We had trouble understanding his accent.（我們很難理解他的口音。）

notes.title: 介系詞後接動名詞
notes.description: 介系詞後若要放動作，改成動名詞。before 或 after 後也能接完整子句，但不能把沒有主詞的原形動詞直接放在介系詞後。
examples: She is good at telling stories.（她擅長說故事。）
How about going sailing?（去駕船如何？）
Wash your hands before eating.（吃東西前要洗手。）

notes.title: 可接兩種形式的動詞
notes.rule: begin / start / like / love / hate＋to V 或 V-ing
notes.description: 在本課的一般情境中，這些動詞可接不定詞或動名詞。遇到選擇題要檢查選項，不能把兩種都正確的形式當成一對正誤。
examples: It began to rain. = It began raining.（開始下雨了。）
He loves to cook. = He loves cooking.（他喜歡做菜。）

notes.title: remember 與 forget：要做還是做過
notes.rule: remember / forget＋to V：記得／忘記要做；remember / forget＋V-ing：記得／忘記做過
notes.description: 先判斷動作是否已發生。提醒未來要做的事情用 to V；回憶或忘記已發生的經驗用 V-ing。照片、回憶、尚未完成等語境比單看時間詞更可靠。
examples: Remember to bring your ticket tomorrow.（記得明天帶票。）
I remember meeting her last year.（我記得去年見過她。）
He forgot to close the door.（他忘記關門了。）
I forgot meeting him until I saw our photo.（直到看到合照，我才想起曾經見過他。）

notes.title: stop：停止原動作或停下來做別的事
notes.rule: stop＋V-ing：停止原動作；stop＋to V：停下來去做另一件事
notes.description: 先找原本正在做什麼。stop talking 是停止聊天；stop to talk 是停下原本的活動，轉而聊天。to V 在此表達停下來的目的。
examples: The children stopped talking when class began.（上課時，孩子們停止聊天。）
We stopped to rest during the walk.（走路途中，我們停下來休息。）

notes.title: 動名詞作主詞
notes.description: 把整件事當作主詞，現在式用 is、helps、takes 等單數形式，過去式用 was。不要被片語內的複數名詞影響。
examples: Eating fresh vegetables is good for you.（吃新鮮蔬菜對你有益。）
Learning new words takes time.（學新單字需要時間。）
Working with those people was fun.（和那些人一起工作很有趣。）

notes.title: 不定詞作主詞
notes.rule: To V 片語＋單數動詞
notes.description: 不定詞片語也可作主詞，整件事視為單數。前面沒有別的主詞時，不要直接用原形動詞來代替這個名詞性片語。
examples: To learn another language takes time.（學另一種語言需要時間。）
To keep the beach clean is important.（保持海灘乾淨很重要。）

notes.title: 虛主詞 it 與句型改寫
notes.description: 用 It 暫代較長的主詞，把不定詞移到後面。for＋人表示對誰而言，可省略。改寫時保留原來的時態與意思。不要寫成 It is easy for he…。
examples: Understanding his accent is hard for me.（理解他的口音對我很難。）
To understand his accent is hard for me.（理解他的口音對我很難。）
It is hard for me to understand his accent.（理解他的口音對我很難。）
It was wonderful for us to camp there.（對我們來說，在那裡露營很棒。）

quiz.question: The sea looks beautiful. I want ___ a photo of it.
quiz.hint: want 後接 to＋原形動詞，因此用 to take；不能直接接 take、taking 或 took。

quiz.question: Our class plans ___ the beach before the summer vacation.
quiz.hint: plans 後接不定詞 to clean，說明計畫要做的事。

quiz.question: Both jobs were interesting, but Helen chose ___ at the farm.
quiz.hint: chose 是 choose 的過去式，後面的受詞仍用 to work；不能因 chose 是過去式就接 worked。

quiz.question: The waiter needs ___ more glasses before the guests arrive.
quiz.hint: needs 在此表示需要做某事，後接 to wash；受詞 glasses 表示由服務生清洗杯子。

quiz.question: The sky turned dark, so the fishermen prepared ___ home.
quiz.hint: prepared 後接 to＋原形動詞，表示準備回家，因此用 to go。

quiz.question: My cousin hopes ___ a lot about local culture during her trip.
quiz.hint: hopes 後接不定詞 to learn，表示希望做的事。

quiz.question: The sign was hard to read, so I asked a worker ___ it to me.
quiz.hint: asked＋人＋to V 表示請某人做某事；a worker 後用 to explain。

quiz.question: Before dinner, Dad told us ___ the fresh vegetables.
quiz.hint: told＋人＋to V 表示告訴某人去做某事，因此 us 後接 to wash。

quiz.question: The waitress is very busy. She wants me ___ these plates for her.
quiz.hint: wants＋人＋to V 表示希望某人做某事，me 後接 to carry。

quiz.question: The sea is dangerous today. Mom told me ___ into the water.
quiz.hint: 這是叫人不要做某事，使用 told＋人＋not to V，因此填 not to go。

quiz.question: The baby is asleep. Please ask your cousin ___ too loudly.
quiz.hint: 嬰兒正在睡覺，所以是請表親不要大聲說話；ask＋人＋not to talk。

quiz.question: I am hungry. Is there anything ___ in the kitchen?
quiz.hint: anything 後接不定詞 to eat，表示可以吃的東西；eat、ate、eats 都不能在此修飾 anything。

quiz.question: Our boat is broken. We must find a way ___ to the beach.
quiz.hint: a way to V 表示做某事的方法；to get 說明到達海灘的方法。

quiz.question: We walked to the station ___ our cousin after her long trip.
quiz.hint: 走到車站的目的是接表親，不定詞 to meet 可以表示目的。

quiz.question: The workers were glad ___ that everyone was safe.
quiz.hint: be glad to V 表示很高興做某事；形容詞 glad 後接 to hear。

quiz.question: A: Would you like to go sailing with us? B: Yes, I would love ___.
quiz.hint: 前句已說 go sailing with us，回答可省略重複內容，但 love 後的不定詞標記 to 要保留。

quiz.question: My sister wanted to camp by the lake, but I did not want ___.
quiz.hint: want to camp by the lake 的重複內容可以省略，保留 to；did not 只使 want 用原形。

quiz.question: After work, the salesman enjoys ___ music on the bus.
quiz.hint: enjoys 後接動名詞，因此用 listening to；to 為 listen to 的一部分，考點仍是 listening 的形式。

quiz.question: We cannot leave yet. The workers have not finished ___ the boat.
quiz.hint: finished 後接 V-ing，表示完成檢查這個動作；have not 不改變 finished 後的接法。

quiz.question: The line is busy, but the waitress keeps ___ the number.
quiz.hint: keeps 後接 V-ing，表示持續打電話，因此用 calling。

quiz.question: Before his trip, Ben practiced ___ simple English questions.
quiz.hint: practiced 後接動名詞 asking，表示練習問問題；不是接過去式 asked。

quiz.question: Would you mind ___ the window? The air in here is not fresh.
quiz.hint: Would you mind＋V-ing 是禮貌請求的句型，mind 後接 opening。

quiz.question: The children had fun ___ about sea turtles at the museum.
quiz.hint: have fun 後可接 V-ing，表示做某事很開心；had fun 後用 learning。

quiz.question: The tourists had trouble ___ the fisherman because of his accent.
quiz.hint: have trouble＋V-ing 表示做某事有困難；口音是難以理解的原因，因此填 understanding。

quiz.question: I am tired of ___ indoors. Let us take a walk on the beach.
quiz.hint: of 是介系詞，後接動名詞 staying；不能接原形、過去式或不定詞。

quiz.question: How about ___ a tent near the river this weekend?
quiz.hint: How about 後接 V-ing，所以用 putting up；put up a tent 表示搭帳篷。

quiz.question: My cousin is good at ___ stories to young children.
quiz.hint: at 是介系詞，be good at 後用 V-ing，因此填 telling。

quiz.question: Please wash your hands before ___ the fresh fruit.
quiz.hint: before 在此後面沒有子句主詞，作介系詞使用，後接動名詞 eating。

quiz.question: The farmer began ___ us around the farm after lunch.
quiz.hint: began 後可接 to show 或 showing；本題選項只有 to show 符合，to showing 的 to 後不是原形。

quiz.question: The sea turtle started ___ toward the water.
quiz.hint: started 後可接 moving 或 to move；選項中只有 moving 符合，to moving 不正確。

quiz.question: My little brother loves ___ pictures of fish.
quiz.hint: loves 後可接 to draw 或 drawing；本題只有 to draw 符合，不能直接接 draw 或 drew。

quiz.question: The waitress hates ___ alone late at night.
quiz.hint: hates 後可接 walking 或 to walk；選項中只有 walking 符合。

quiz.question: The fisherman likes ___ his boat before breakfast.
quiz.hint: likes 後可接 to check 或 checking；本題提供的正確形式是 to check。

quiz.question: The door is still open. Please remember ___ it before you leave.
quiz.hint: 門還開著，表示關門尚未完成；remember to close 是記得要去關門，remember closing 則是記得關過。

quiz.question: I remember ___ that sea turtle last year. I still have a photo of it.
quiz.hint: last year 和保留照片表示事情已發生；remember seeing 是記得曾經看過。

quiz.question: Our tickets are still on the table. Do not forget ___ them tomorrow.
quiz.hint: tomorrow 表示提醒未來要做的事，使用 forget to bring；bringing 會變成忘記曾帶過的經驗。

quiz.question: I forgot ___ Ken at the beach last year until he showed me our photo.
quiz.hint: 照片證明去年已見過面，只是忘了這段經驗；forget meeting 表示忘記見過，to meet 表示忘記赴約。

quiz.question: The teacher is speaking now. Please stop ___ and listen.
quiz.hint: 老師正在說話，要求停止聊天來聽講；stop talking 是停止原本的動作，stop to talk 是停下來去聊天。

quiz.question: We were walking to the farm when we got thirsty, so we stopped ___ some water.
quiz.hint: 原本在走路，因口渴而停下來喝水；stop to drink 表示停下原本的事去喝水。

quiz.question: The phone was ringing, but it stopped ___ when I picked it up.
quiz.hint: 原本電話正在響，拿起後鈴聲停止；stop ringing 是停止響鈴，to ring 會變成停下來去響鈴。

quiz.question: On his way home, the salesman stopped ___ some bread for dinner.
quiz.hint: 原本在回家途中，中途停下來買晚餐的麵包；stop to buy 表示停下原本的活動去買東西。

quiz.question: ___ English with my cousin is fun.
quiz.hint: 空格開頭的片語作整句主詞，需用動名詞 Speaking；後面的 is 是主要動詞。

quiz.question: Learning about another culture ___ time.
quiz.hint: Learning about another culture 是一整件事，視為單數主詞，現在式主要動詞用 takes。

quiz.question: ___ the boat after every trip helps keep it clean.
quiz.hint: 空格所在的片語作主詞，要用動名詞 Washing；helps 才是整句的主要動詞。

quiz.question: To practice these words every day ___ important.
quiz.hint: To practice these words every day 整體作單數主詞，不受 words 為複數影響，因此用 is。

quiz.question: It is dangerous ___ on this beach during a storm.
quiz.hint: It is＋形容詞＋to V，It 代替後面的不定詞內容；to camp 表示露營這件事。

quiz.question: It is easy for the friendly worker ___ new friends.
quiz.hint: It is easy for＋人＋to V 表示對某人來說做某事很容易，因此填 to make。

quiz.question: It is hard for ___ to understand this accent.
quiz.hint: for 是介系詞，後接受格 him；he 是主格，his 是所有格，此處沒有使用反身代名詞的條件。

quiz.question: ___ is important to bring enough water when you go camping.
quiz.hint: 句末 to bring enough water…才是實際內容，句首用虛主詞 It；There、They、These 不符此句型。

quiz.question: Working in that factory ___ a useful experience for my father last summer.
quiz.hint: Working in that factory 整體是單數主詞，last summer 提示過去時間，因此用 was；不能因 factory 後有其他字就改成複數。

vocab.sentence: My cousin hopes to visit Taiwan.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我的表弟希望來臺灣玩。

vocab.sentence: She wants to find a new job.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她想找一份新工作。

vocab.sentence: He hopes to work as a cook.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他希望擔任廚師。

vocab.sentence: The waiter finished cleaning the table.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位男服務生擦完了桌子。

vocab.sentence: I want to live near the beach.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我想住在海灘附近。

vocab.sentence: It is amazing to see sea turtles.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 看到海龜令人驚喜。

vocab.sentence: Working on a farm was a great experience.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 在農場工作是很棒的經驗。

vocab.sentence: We enjoy getting some fresh air outside.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們喜歡到外面呼吸新鮮空氣。

vocab.sentence: Dad wants to buy some fresh fish.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 爸爸想買一些新鮮的魚。

vocab.sentence: We enjoy swimming in the clear water.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們喜歡在清澈的水中游泳。

vocab.sentence: We hope to see a coral reef.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們希望看到珊瑚礁。

vocab.sentence: Watching sea turtles is a lot of fun.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 看海龜非常有趣。

vocab.sentence: They plan to clean the beach tomorrow.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他們計畫明天清理海灘。

vocab.sentence: I want to learn about different cultures.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我想認識不同的文化。

vocab.sentence: You should practice speaking English every day.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你應該每天練習說英文。

vocab.sentence: We prepared to leave early this morning.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 今天早上我們準備提早離開。

vocab.sentence: Keep practicing, and you will make progress.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 持續練習，你就會進步。

vocab.sentence: My sister practices singing after school.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我妹妹放學後練習唱歌。

vocab.sentence: Give me a break! I just finished working.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 饒了我吧！我才剛工作完。

vocab.sentence: No kidding! He plans to work abroad.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 不開玩笑的！他計畫到國外工作。

vocab.sentence: It is important to keep the beach clean.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 保持海灘乾淨很重要。

vocab.sentence: My cousin wants to learn to surf.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我的表弟想學衝浪。

vocab.sentence: They enjoy working on their uncle's farm.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他們喜歡在叔叔的農場工作。

vocab.sentence: The workers stopped working at five.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 工人們在 5 點停止工作。

vocab.sentence: The waitress needs to clean these tables.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位女服務生需要清理這些桌子。

vocab.sentence: He hopes to work in this factory.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他希望在這間工廠工作。

vocab.sentence: The salesman tried to help us.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位業務員試著幫助我們。

vocab.sentence: The fisherman finished cleaning his boat.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位漁夫清理完他的船。

vocab.sentence: The friendly worker offered to help me.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位友善的工人主動提出要幫我。

vocab.sentence: Learning about another culture is interesting.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 認識另一種文化很有趣。

vocab.sentence: She hopes to make progress in English.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她希望英文能進步。

vocab.sentence: Watching these plants grow is fun.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 看著這些植物成長很有趣。

vocab.sentence: I tried to understand his question.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我試著理解他的問題。

vocab.sentence: Understanding her accent is difficult for me.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 理解她的口音對我來說很困難。

vocab.sentence: Please remember to leave a message.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 請記得留言。

vocab.sentence: My brother likes to surf with friends.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我哥哥喜歡和朋友一起衝浪。

vocab.sentence: They hope to sail around the island.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他們希望駕船繞島航行。

vocab.sentence: We plan to camp near the lake.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們計畫在湖邊露營。

vocab.sentence: It began to rain after lunch.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 午餐後開始下雨。

vocab.sentence: We decided to end the game early.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們決定提早結束遊戲。

vocab.sentence: I hope to visit my cousin soon.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我希望很快就能去看我的表姊。

vocab.sentence: He was unhappy to hear the news.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 聽到這個消息，他很不開心。

phrases.sentence: Long time no see. How are you?
What a surprise! You work here, too.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 真讓人驚訝！你也在這裡工作。

phrases.sentence: What are you up to these days?
I hope to go on a working holiday.
What kind of job do you want?
She hopes to work as a waitress.
Please keep practicing with your classmates.
Give me a break! I need to rest.
No kidding! My cousin can sail a boat.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 不開玩笑的！我的表哥會駕船。

phrases.sentence: We want to learn about sea turtles.
Practicing every day helps you make progress.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 每天練習有助於你進步。

phrases.sentence: In short, learning English takes time.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 簡而言之，學英文需要時間。

phrases.sentence: My cousins enjoy sailing on weekends.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我的表兄弟週末喜歡駕船航行。

grammar.sentence: My cousin wants to work as a waiter.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我的表哥想擔任男服務生。

grammar.sentence: We enjoy learning about different cultures after school.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們喜歡放學後認識不同的文化。

grammar.sentence: It is important to keep the water clean.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 保持水質乾淨很重要。

grammar.sentence: The farmer asked us to pick some oranges.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 農夫請我們採一些柳橙。

grammar.sentence: Please remember to bring your lunch tomorrow.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請記得明天帶午餐。

grammar.sentence: Watching sea turtles was an amazing experience.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 看海龜是很棒的經驗。

grammar.sentence: They plan to sail around the island.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他們計畫駕船繞島航行。

grammar.sentence: My sister finished cleaning her room before dinner.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我妹妹晚餐前打掃完她的房間。

grammar.sentence: The guide told us not to touch the fish.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 導遊告訴我們不要碰那些魚。

grammar.sentence: I stopped to rest after walking for hours.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 走了幾個小時後，我停下來休息。

grammar.sentence: Learning a new language takes a lot of time.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 學習新語言需要很多時間。

grammar.sentence: The workers prepared to leave the factory early.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 工人們準備提早離開工廠。

grammar.sentence: My cousin is good at telling funny stories.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我的表姊擅長說有趣的故事。

grammar.sentence: It was difficult for her to understand him.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 理解他的話對她來說很困難。

grammar.sentence: The children kept asking questions about the farm.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 孩子們不停地問關於農場的問題。

grammar.sentence: He forgot to buy fresh vegetables yesterday.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他昨天忘了買新鮮蔬菜。

grammar.sentence: We went outside to get some fresh air.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們到外面呼吸一些新鮮空氣。

grammar.sentence: She remembers seeing that fisherman at the beach.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她記得曾在海灘見過那位漁夫。

grammar.sentence: To learn about another culture is interesting.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 認識另一種文化很有趣。

grammar.sentence: Would you mind closing the window for me?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 可以請你幫我關窗嗎？

grammar.sentence: The boy stopped crying when his mother arrived.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 男孩在媽媽到達時停止哭泣。

grammar.sentence: Our teacher hopes to visit Japan next year.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們的老師希望明年去日本。

grammar.sentence: You should wash your hands before eating lunch.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你應該在吃午餐前洗手。

grammar.sentence: The friendly waitress was happy to help us.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那位友善的女服務生很樂意幫我們。

grammar.sentence: We need something to drink after the game.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 比賽後我們需要一些喝的東西。

grammar.sentence: She practices speaking English with her cousin daily.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她每天和表姊練習說英文。

grammar.sentence: It is fun for us to go camping.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 對我們來說，去露營很有趣。

grammar.sentence: The salesman began to explain the new phone.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 業務員開始介紹那支新手機。

grammar.sentence: I would love to visit that coral reef.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我很想去看看那座珊瑚礁。

grammar.sentence: Working on the farm helped him grow.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 在農場工作幫助他成長。

cloze_quiz.question: My aunt has one daughter. That girl is my ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 阿姨的女兒和我是表姊妹，cousin 是堂、表兄弟姊妹。

cloze_quiz.question: Mia needs money, so she is looking for a ___ at a restaurant.
cloze_quiz.hint: needs money 和餐廳求職是線索；job 表示工作。

cloze_quiz.question: Eric works ___ a tour guide and shows visitors around the city.
cloze_quiz.hint: work as＋職業表示擔任某種工作，as 是以……的身分。

cloze_quiz.question: The man who brings our food to the table is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: man 和把餐點送到桌邊是線索；waiter 是男服務生。

cloze_quiz.question: My grandparents ___ in Kaohsiung. Their house is near a park.
cloze_quiz.hint: 後句提到住家位置，live in 表示住在某地。

cloze_quiz.question: The boy can speak ten languages. That is ___!
cloze_quiz.hint: 會說十種語言讓人驚訝，amazing 表示非常驚人的。

cloze_quiz.question: This is my first time working in a hotel, so I have no hotel work ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 第一次在旅館工作表示沒有相關工作經驗；experience 是經驗。

cloze_quiz.question: Fish live in water, but people need ___ to breathe.
cloze_quiz.hint: breathe 是呼吸，人需要空氣 air。

cloze_quiz.question: These eggs came from our hens this morning. They are very ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 今早才生的蛋很新鮮；fresh 是新鮮的。

cloze_quiz.question: The water is so ___ that we can see the stones at the bottom.
cloze_quiz.hint: 看得見水底石頭，表示水很清澈，應用 clear。

cloze_quiz.question: We saw many small fish living among the corals of the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: corals 是珊瑚，魚生活在珊瑚礁中；coral reef 是珊瑚礁。

cloze_quiz.question: The animal has a shell, lives in the ocean, and lays eggs on the sand. It is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 有殼且在沙地產卵的海洋動物是海龜 sea turtle。

cloze_quiz.question: The children built a sandcastle on the ___ beside the sea.
cloze_quiz.hint: 海邊堆沙堡的地點是沙灘，beach 是海灘。

cloze_quiz.question: I am very hungry, and I ___ to eat dinner now.
cloze_quiz.hint: 飢餓而想吃晚餐，want 表示想要。

cloze_quiz.question: You have a high fever. You ___ see a doctor.
cloze_quiz.hint: 發高燒時建議看醫生，should 表示應該；其他選項分別表示禁止、不能、不必。

cloze_quiz.question: The guests will arrive soon. We need to ___ dinner before they come.
cloze_quiz.hint: 客人即將到，應事先準備晚餐；prepare 是準備。

cloze_quiz.question: The baby is asleep. Please ___ your voice down.
cloze_quiz.hint: keep your voice down 表示保持低音量；keep 有保持的意思。

cloze_quiz.question: To get better at the piano, I ___ for thirty minutes every day.
cloze_quiz.hint: 每天練琴才能進步，practice 是練習。

cloze_quiz.question: A: Clean all ten rooms by yourself right now! B: ___ That is too much work!
cloze_quiz.hint: 認為工作量太多，說 Give me a break! 表示饒了我吧。

cloze_quiz.question: A: Did you really catch ten fish today? B: ___ I can show you all ten.
cloze_quiz.hint: 後句表示能出示十條魚，No kidding! 在此強調沒有開玩笑，確實如此。

cloze_quiz.question: Water is ___ to all living things. They cannot live without it.
cloze_quiz.hint: 沒有水就無法存活，表示水很重要；important 是重要的。

cloze_quiz.question: I do not know how to cook, but I want to ___ from my mother.
cloze_quiz.hint: 目前不會做菜，想向媽媽學習，learn 是學習。

cloze_quiz.question: Uncle Ben grows rice and raises cows on his ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 種稻與養牛的地方是農場 farm。

cloze_quiz.question: The man builds houses for a living. He is a construction ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: construction worker 是建築工人；worker 表示工人。

cloze_quiz.question: The woman who takes our order at this restaurant is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: woman 和在餐廳幫客人點餐是線索；waitress 是女服務生。

cloze_quiz.question: Hundreds of workers make cars inside that large ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 工人製造汽車的地方是工廠 factory。

cloze_quiz.question: The man at the car store helps customers choose and buy cars. He is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 在店裡協助顧客選購汽車的是業務員，salesman 是推銷員或業務員。

cloze_quiz.question: The ___ takes his boat out every morning to catch fish for a living.
cloze_quiz.hint: 以出海捕魚維生的是漁夫 fisherman。

cloze_quiz.question: Our new neighbor is ___. She always smiles and welcomes us warmly.
cloze_quiz.hint: 微笑並熱情歡迎別人，表示待人友善，friendly 是友善的。

cloze_quiz.question: Food, festivals, and music can teach us about a country's ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 食物、節慶和音樂屬於文化，culture 是文化。

cloze_quiz.question: I could read only ten words before, but now I can read a hundred. I have made ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 從十個字增加到一百個字表示有進步，make progress 是進步。

cloze_quiz.question: Plants need sunlight and water to ___ taller.
cloze_quiz.hint: 植物需要陽光與水才能長高，grow 是成長。

cloze_quiz.question: Please speak more slowly. I cannot ___ what you are saying.
cloze_quiz.hint: 請人慢慢說是因為聽不懂，understand 表示了解。

cloze_quiz.question: He speaks English with an Australian ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 說英文時帶有澳洲口音，accent 是口音。

cloze_quiz.question: No one answered the phone, so I decided to ___ a message.
cloze_quiz.hint: leave a message 表示留言；leave 在此是留下。

cloze_quiz.question: I want to stand on a board and ride the ocean waves. Please teach me to ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 站在板上乘著海浪前進是衝浪，surf 是衝浪。

cloze_quiz.question: When there is enough wind, we can ___ this small boat across the lake.
cloze_quiz.hint: 有風時操作帆船航行，sail 表示駕船或航行。

cloze_quiz.question: We plan to sleep in a tent and ___ in the mountains tonight.
cloze_quiz.hint: 在山裡睡帳篷表示露營，camp 是露營。

cloze_quiz.question: The movie will ___ at seven, so please be in your seat before then.
cloze_quiz.hint: 要在七點前就座，因為電影七點開始，begin 是開始。

cloze_quiz.question: The movie started at seven and will ___ at nine. Then we can go home.
cloze_quiz.hint: 電影七點開始、九點結束，之後能回家，end 是結束。

cloze_quiz.question: I ___ to see you again soon. I really enjoyed our time together.
cloze_quiz.hint: 相處愉快，所以希望很快再見面，hope 是希望。

cloze_quiz.question: Amy lost her favorite toy and cried. She was very ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 失去心愛的玩具而哭泣，表示不開心；unhappy 是不快樂的。
